title: Linux for engineers
summary: Navigate, secure, package, schedule and troubleshoot a Linux server the way production work demands.

title: Git and version control
summary: Track changes with Git: commits, branches, merging, rebase, remotes, pull requests, tags, hooks, large repositories, and recovery when things go wrong.

title: Shell scripting
summary: Write Bash scripts that fail loudly, run safely, parse JSON from APIs and replace repetitive manual work.

title: Python for automation
summary: Write Python scripts that handle files, processes, HTTP APIs and cloud SDKs, with tests and a packaged command-line tool.

title: Networking essentials
summary: Reason about addresses, DNS, HTTP, TLS and firewalls well enough to debug any connectivity failure.

title: Docker and containers
summary: Build small, secure images, run multi-container applications, and understand registries, runtimes and the OCI standard.

title: CI/CD and delivery
summary: Design pipelines that build, test and ship safely, secure the supply chain, and deploy with rolling, canary and declarative delivery.

title: Kubernetes
summary: Run workloads on Kubernetes from architecture and networking to Helm, autoscaling, operators, cluster upgrades, RBAC, troubleshooting and exam strategy.

title: Terraform and infrastructure as code
summary: Describe infrastructure as code, use advanced HCL, manage state and secrets safely, and build real AWS and Azure stacks.

title: Cloud platforms: AWS and Azure
summary: Core concepts side by side on AWS and Azure: identity, networks, DNS and CDN, compute, serverless, managed Kubernetes, security, monitoring and cost.

title: Observability
summary: Instrument systems with metrics, logs and traces, ship them with OpenTelemetry, probe from outside, and alert on what users actually feel.

title: Site reliability engineering
summary: Define reliability with SLOs, respond to incidents, run on-call, plan capacity, practise failure and manage change safely.

title: DevSecOps and security
summary: Build security into delivery: threat modeling, secrets, pipeline and supply chain checks, container and Kubernetes hardening, cloud identity and incident response.

title: Ansible and configuration management
summary: Describe servers in inventories and playbooks, keep them consistent with idempotent roles, protect secrets with Vault and roll changes out safely.

title: Databases for operators
summary: Run relational databases with confidence: SQL, indexes and plans, transactions, backups, replication, safe migrations, caches and incident triage.

title: Go for DevOps engineers
summary: Write small, fast, reliable Go services and tools: types, errors, interfaces, goroutines, context, HTTP, testing, containers and debugging.

title: Helm for beginners
summary: Package, configure, upgrade and roll back Kubernetes applications with Helm: charts, values, templates, releases, dependencies and debugging.

title: Cloud security and IAM
summary: Control who and what can do what in the cloud: identities, roles and policies on AWS and Azure, least privilege, secrets and keys, private networking, audit logs and debugging access errors.

title: Kubernetes administration and operations
summary: Run clusters, not only apps: control plane and etcd, backups, safe upgrades, RBAC, node maintenance, quotas and autoscaling, network and pod security, and debugging cluster faults.

title: Continuous delivery with Argo CD
summary: Deliver to Kubernetes by letting a controller pull the desired state from a repository: applications, sync and drift, Helm and Kustomize, environments, hooks, access and debugging.

title: LLM fundamentals
summary: Understand how large language models work in practice: tokens, context windows, sampling, training, API calls, cost, latency, evaluation and debugging.

title: Prompting and structured output
summary: Write reliable prompts, give examples, ask for step-by-step reasoning, get validated JSON back, and version and test your prompts.

title: Claude Skills
summary: Package expertise as skills Claude loads on demand: SKILL.md, descriptions that trigger, progressive disclosure, scripts, testing, sharing and security.

title: Tool use and MCP
summary: Let models call tools safely: function calling, the tool-use loop, the Model Context Protocol, building a server, permissions and prompt injection.

title: System design for platform and SRE
summary: Design systems that fail small: estimation, caching, queues, consistency, quorums, cells, shuffle sharding, load shedding, multi-region, change safety, and worked designs reviewed against real outages.

title: MLOps: machine learning in production
summary: Run models like any other production system: data checks, reproducible training, tested pipelines, a model registry, safe releases, serving, and monitoring for drift with a retraining loop.

title: AIOps: algorithms for operations
summary: Use statistics and machine learning to help run systems: anomaly detection, alert correlation, log and trace patterns, root cause hints, incident assistants and safe auto-remediation.

title: Virtualization
summary: Understand hypervisors, CPU and memory overcommit, virtual disks and snapshots, virtual networks and live migration, and troubleshoot a KVM host.

title: Storage and filesystems
summary: Choose block, file or object storage, manage ext4 and XFS, LVM and RAID, NFS, iSCSI and Ceph, and diagnose slow or full disks.

title: SQL performance and database operations
summary: Read query plans, add the right indexes, untangle locks, size connection pools and run replication, vacuum and day-two operations.

title: GPU, AI infrastructure and LLM serving
summary: Know what limits inference on a GPU, run vLLM, TGI and Triton, schedule GPUs on Kubernetes, and control latency and cost.

title: OpenStack and private cloud
summary: Run a private cloud: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder and Glance, quotas, scheduling, networking and day-two operations.

title: Bare metal and datacenter
summary: Rack, provision and operate physical servers: BMC and IPMI, PXE provisioning, disks and RAID, leaf-spine networking and fleet operations.

title: Service mesh and Kubernetes networking
summary: Understand pod networking, CNI and network policy, then run a service mesh with mTLS, traffic routing and troubleshooting.

title: Reverse proxies and load balancers
summary: Run nginx, HAProxy and Envoy in front of services: routing, TLS, load balancing, timeouts, caching, rate limits and debugging 502 and 504 errors.

title: Messaging and streaming
summary: Choose and operate queues and logs: RabbitMQ and Kafka, delivery guarantees, consumer groups, lag, retention, schemas and managed cloud services.

title: CloudFormation and Bicep
summary: Write and operate cloud-native infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and Azure Bicep, change previews, stacks, modules, testing and debugging failed deployments.

title: Google Cloud
summary: Learn the Google Cloud model: projects, VPC, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Run, data and messaging services, operations and cost, with the gcloud CLI.
